text: Ɓen gomɗimɓe Alla ɓe bajjinɗini Mo, ɓe kafidaali goɗɗo goo, ɓe goongini Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen den- ndaangal, ɓe senndaali hakkunde gooto e maɓɓe wano heeferɓe ɓen gerdiri ; ɓen ɗon, arma Alla Okka ɓe njoɓdi Mawndi e ngal gomɗinal maɓɓe e golle maɓɓe moƴƴe. Alla Laatike Yaafotooɗo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
